deck.name: Expanded Starter Phrase Deck
deck.description: Expanded prototype deck with approximately 120 cards. The deck preserves tonal-family boundaries while adding enough variety for richer phrase selection and more realistic round-to-round play.
deck.author: Copilot
deck.notes: This expanded deck keeps four tonal families and broadens the available phrase vocabulary without introducing unrelated key families. It is designed for prototyping and further balance tuning.
